notes: Modified cash basis school district. Top-level receipts/disbursements use the Total Governmental Funds column of the Statement of Receipts, Disbursements, and Changes in Fund Balances (trimmed p4). Total-column transfers are blank (GF -75,000 / other funds +75,000 eliminate), so transfers_in/out are null. Beginning cash = beginning fund balances 3,946,642 (p5); ending cash 4,836,824 (p5, also p6). Balance sheet uses the cash-basis Statement of Net Position (p3); no liabilities printed. Detail: General Fund recorded from the budget-and-actual schedule (p9-13) rather than the less detailed combining schedule (p7-8, not recorded to avoid double counting); the Depreciation, Employee Benefit and Community Improvement Cash funds (part of Total General Fund on p7-8) and the other funds are recorded per fund. GF schedule total disbursements 6,541,647 includes transfers to Activities (25,000) and School Nutrition (50,000); the p8 Reclassifications column shows a further 150,000 transfer (to Depreciation Fund, received p14) hidden inside the student transportation lines, recorded as a negative contra expenditure plus an other financing item (so expenditure items 6,316,647 + 225,000 transfers = 6,541,647). Budget amounts on group heading rows (2200 162,000; 6000 250,572; 8000 Other 1,900,000) not attached to lines. Zero or blank 2025 lines (2540, 2712, 3535 total state line 3900, 1335) skipped. State/federal program expenditure lines are placed in instruction because the p8 reclassification moves 313,015 (8,488+304,527) to Instruction. Student support services (p4) split by fund column: General Fund 320,614 support services; Other Governmental Funds 374,737 (Activities Fund spending, p16) student activities. Read pages 1-20 of 20.
